title: Restore bool validation in the host sanitizer jobs
problem: The historical blanket bool suppression can hide undefined behavior after the old formatting path has been replaced.
design: Remove only the obsolete -fno-sanitize=bool exception and its explanation; preserve the matrix and all commands.
tradeoffs: Dependency/toolchain bool defects now fail CI as well. A new suppression would need a demonstrated scoped reason.

validation.results: Pending independent review and assembled portable validation.
validation.limitations: Validate sanitizers with GCC and Clang after migration. This stage does not change hosted readiness, coverage policy or corpus selection.

source_changes: Build integration and documentation only; no formatter implementation changes.
